configuration: Written cases drive the note editor's own path on macOS: an NSTextView set up as RichTextPlatformEditor.makeNSView sets it (rich text, undo, the 13-point system font, its inset, no background), loaded as initialAttributed() loads a note (the stored RTF, else the plain body), with RichTextEditorController given the view as the representable gives it. Text is typed with insertText(_:replacementRange:); bold, italic, underline and links go through the controller's toggleBold(), toggleItalic(), toggleUnderline() and applyLink(_:) after refreshSelectionState(), as the formatting bar's buttons call them; a colour is applied as colorPanelDidPick(_:) applies the panel's colour, which mac-golden cannot open; text pasted with other attributes is inserted as an attributed string. The RTF is what report(_:) stores on macOS: RichTextRestingText.withBreaksRestored, then ProseRichText.rtfData(from:). Read and web cases are files under fixtures/rich-text. Every case is read under the aqua appearance, since the app's reading of a dynamic colour follows the appearance current when it runs: text is NSAttributedString.string of ProseRichText.decodedRTF; runs are its enumerateAttributes runs, unmerged, each read by CollectionProse's span rules (bold and italic from the font's symbolic traits, underline from a nonzero underline style, the colour through usingColorSpace(.sRGB) with near-black as none, the link's absoluteString or string); paragraphs are CollectionProse.paragraphs(fromRTF:). Catalog colours are each key of the System colour list, as an RTF \cname entry, read the same way. Each written and read case is also rewritten: the web's codec (FRUSRichText) reads it, writes its runs in canonical form with RTFWriter, as the server stores a web edit, and the app reads that RTF the same way. Code pages are ParityFormat's RichTextCodePages documents, every text byte and double-byte pair in a group of its own, read by ProseRichText.decodedRTF; the web's codec must read each the same before its digest is recorded. A release build of the app module, with testing enabled, compiled from the submodule unmodified.
